newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap rises on higher Debis stake hopes.
newsitem.headline: Cap rises on higher Debis stake hopes.

text.p: Shares in computer systems house Cap Gemini firmed on Thursday on hopes investor Daimler-Benz inter Services AG (Debis) could up its stake if U.S. legislation allowed such a move, traders said.

Debis chairman Klaus Mangold told German newspaper Boersen-Zeitung on Monday he was still interested in increasing Debis's 24.4 percent stake in Cap Gemini but that U.S. stock laws had hindered attempts to raise its holding. But he expected a decision on a stake increase in the first half of 1997 if the legal obstacles could be cleared.
Cap traded up 2.43 percent to 252.90 francs at 1135 GMT.

Debis is caught by U.S. laws restricting any bank or its subsidiaries from holding more than 25 percent of a company in the United States as Deutsche Bank holds the majority of Debis' capital if in addition to its direct 20 percent holding, the shares it handles are taken into account.
